beta.title: Beta 4
beta.notes:
Calibrate first: until then readings show dBFS.
A calibrator on the mic pauses readings and dose on its own (turn off Calibrator pause for sine sweeps).
Saving a calibration starts the readings over and notes the change in the report.
Reset averages: tap an LAeq number twice.
RTA range setting, including dBFS to -140.
More accurate A and C weighting above 8 kHz.
